import pandas as pd

def compute_missingness(input_file, output_report, output_matrix):
    # Read the input file
    df = pd.read_csv(input_file)
    
    # Compute missingness per indicator
    missingness = df.isnull().sum() / len(df)
    
    # Create the missingness report
    report = pd.DataFrame({'indicator': missingness.index, 'missing_count': missingness.values, 'missing_rate': missingness.values})
    
    # Determine which indicators to keep
    kept_indicators = missingness[missingness <= 0.30].index
    
    # Filter the matrix to keep only the kept indicators
    df_selected = df.loc[:, ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + list(kept_indicators)]
    
    # Write the missingness report
    report.to_csv(output_report, index=False)
    
    # Write the selected matrix
    df_selected.to_csv(output_matrix, index=False)

# Compute missingness and select indicators
compute_missingness('inputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv', 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv')
